en.intro: Listen closely to the word that tells us why the unmanifest path is so difficult, and why embodied beings find it hard.
en.notice: Krishna warns that minds set on the unmanifest face more struggle, since embodied people find that path hard.
en.next: Krishna now turns to the easier path of single-pointed devotion to a personal form.
en.meaning: For those whose minds cling to the unmanifest, the struggle is greater. The unmanifest path is hard to reach for embodied beings.

hi.intro: उस शब्द को ध्यान से सुनिए जो बताता है कि अव्यक्त का मार्ग इतना कठिन क्यों है, और देहाभिमानियों के लिए यह मुश्किल क्यों है।
hi.meaning: जिनका चित्त अव्यक्त में लगा रहता है, उनके लिए क्लेश अधिक होता है क्योंकि देहधारी पुरुषों द्वारा अव्यक्त की गति को प्राप्त करना कठिन होता है।
hi.notice: कलेशः, यानी कठिनाई, को अधिकतरः, यानी अधिक, से जोड़ा गया है। कृष्ण कहते हैं कि जिनके मन अव्यक्त में लगे हैं, उनके लिए क्लेश अधिक है क्योंकि देहधारी लोग उस सूक्ष्म गति को आसानी से प्राप्त नहीं कर पाते।
hi.next: कृष्ण अब एकल भक्ति के आसान मार्ग की ओर मुड़ते हैं, जो एक व्यक्तिगत रूप पर केंद्रित है।

en.intro: Listen closely to the word that tells us why the unmanifest path is so difficult, and why embodied beings find it hard.
en.body: For those whose minds cling to the unmanifest, the struggle is greater. The unmanifest path is hard to reach for embodied beings. Krishna warns that minds set on the unmanifest face more struggle, since embodied people find that path hard. Krishna now turns to the easier path of single-pointed devotion to a personal form.

unsupported: "Listen closely to the word that tells us why the unmanifest path is so difficult" (The source (Sanskrit verse 5) does not say 'the word' (singular) tells us why the path is difficult. It states that the struggle (क्लेशः) is greater for those attached to the unmanifest. The intro invents a specific 'word' as the singular explanation, which is not supported by the verse's structure or meaning.)

meaning_changed: "कृष्ण कहते हैं कि जिनके मन अव्यक्त में लगे हैं, उनके लिए क्लेश अधिक है क्योंकि देहधारी लोग उस सूक्ष्म गति को आसानी से प्राप्त नहीं कर पाते।" (The word 'आसानी से' (easily) completely contradicts the source meaning of 'दुःखम्' (painful/difficult/hard to reach) and 'अवाप्यते' (is reached). The source explicitly states the path is difficult to reach, not easy to reach.)

meaning_changed: "कृष्ण अब एकल भक्ति के आसान मार्ग की ओर मुड़ते हैं, जो एक व्यक्तिगत रूप पर केंद्रित है।" (The Hindi phrase 'आसान मार्ग' (easy path) misrepresents the source meaning. The source for verse 6 simply describes the path of single-pointed devotion to a personal form; it does not characterize it as 'easy' or 'simple' in this context.)
